title: Scrollbar disappears in long menu
description: The menu list scrolls normally, although its scrollbar disappears once the number of entries gets large.

title: Keybinding label shows old shortcut
description: After I change an action's key binding, the controls page still displays the previous shortcut.

title: Chat messages arrive out of order
description: Messages sent in quick succession by two players occasionally appear in a different order on their chat panels.

title: High latency warning missing
description: During severe simulated latency, the game continues without displaying any connection quality warning.

title: Remote player position stops updating
description: A remote character stops moving on screen for several seconds and then suddenly jumps to a new position.

title: Environmental sound disappears after reload
description: An ambient sound source is audible before saving, but its audio disappears after loading that save.

title: Notification sound ignores mute setting
description: The notification tone still plays even after sound effects have been muted in the audio settings.

title: Map legend remains hidden behind quest tracker
description: At the default interface scale, expanding the map legend places its last two entries underneath the pinned quest tracker.

title: Crafting recipe text uses wrong quantity
description: The crafting panel shows two components required, although the recipe details list three.

title: Volume value does not match slider position
description: Dragging the master volume slider to its minimum leaves the displayed numeric value at 10.

title: Multiple menu tabs appear selected
description: Switching quickly between audio and video settings leaves both tabs styled as active.

title: Subtitle background blocks dialogue choices
description: With large subtitles enabled, the subtitle panel overlays the lowest dialogue response.

title: Consumable disappears without effect
description: Using a healing item during a climb removes one item from the stack without restoring health.

title: Enemy loses target after short obstacle
description: An enemy stops pursuing the player permanently when the player walks behind a small crate, even after line of sight returns.

title: Checkpoint reload places player inside rock
description: Loading the latest checkpoint occasionally places the player inside nearby terrain instead of on the path.

title: Shield blocks damage from behind
description: An enemy attack from behind is negated while the player holds a forward facing shield.

title: Crafting queue finishes without materials
description: Canceling and immediately restarting a craft can produce the item without consuming the required resources.

title: Save reload duplicates collected key
description: After collecting a unique key and reloading the save, the key appears both in inventory and at its original location.

title: Quest completion fails with full inventory
description: Finishing a delivery quest while the backpack is full leaves the quest marked incomplete even though the item was handed over.

title: Lobby invitation expires immediately
description: A newly generated party invitation is reported as expired when accepted within a few seconds.

title: Party chat repeats after reconnect
description: Rejoining an online lobby causes the latest party chat message to appear a second time.

title: Remote interaction prompt never clears
description: A guest continues to see an interaction prompt for an object the host already removed from the world.

title: Remote damage arrives twice
description: A guest is hit once by an enemy attack but receives two damage events during temporary packet loss.

title: Autosave causes visible stutter
description: Each autosave produces a short interruption in character movement while the save icon is displayed.

title: Asset loading pauses traversal
description: Moving rapidly between adjacent zones causes terrain objects to appear late and movement to halt briefly.

title: Window mode switch hangs for several seconds
description: Switching from fullscreen to borderless mode makes the application unresponsive for several seconds before the display updates.

title: Repeated map opening increases memory footprint
description: The process memory footprint grows each time the world map is opened and never returns to its earlier level.

title: Background loading blocks audio and input
description: Entering a new area briefly freezes character controls and audio while assets stream in.

title: Large inventory slows item sorting
description: Sorting an inventory with many unique items takes several seconds while the interface is blocked.

title: Camera rotation stutters near moving lights
description: Rotating the camera near multiple moving light sources causes periodic frame time spikes.

title: Dialogue voice missing after loading save
description: Loading a save during dialogue resumes subtitles but not the accompanying recorded voice.

title: Water sounds continue on dry land
description: After leaving a river, splash and water ambience continue while the player walks on a stone path.

title: Voice lines overlap at conversation end
description: Selecting a dialogue response before the previous line finishes causes both voice lines to play at once.

title: Footstep material sound mismatches surface
description: Walking across a wooden bridge plays the same metallic footstep sound heard on a metal floor.

title: Inventory pickup sound missing for stacked items
description: Picking up a second item into an existing stack updates the item count but does not play a pickup sound.
